FOFSMCPDC is an efficient controller for the control of nonlinear, time varying and uncertain complex systems.

the design of FOFSMCPDP controller to control the nonlinear complex system.
the design of a FOFSMCPDC for nonlinear complex systems.
the design of a fractional order fuzzy SMC controller to control a nonlinear complex system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed controller is very effective for the control of a nonlinear, timevarying, uncertain, coupled MIMO complex system.
the proposed controller is able to control effectively the complex system and it can be used for controlling other complex systems.
the FOFSMCD controller is more robust and effective than the integer order SMC controller.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a robust controller is needed to control a complex nonlinear system and the FOFSMPCPD is an efficient robust controller.
a FOFSMCPDC is presented for the first time to control nonlinear, uncertain, MIMO, complex systems and the controller performance is better than integer order SMC.
a fractional order SMC controller is presented for the first time to control a two-link planar rigid robot manipulator system.

a fractional order sliding mode controller with fuzzy logic can control effectively a nonlinear complex system.
